title: Registrar's rules
text:
About the registrar’s rules

 The Registrar of Companies is given authority to make rules governing the filing of documents at Companies House. This includes:

 • filing your Companies House information online 

 • paper forms to register and file information with Companies House 

 These rules are made under section 1117 of the Companies Act 2006 and must be complied with whenever a document is delivered to Companies House.

 Links to the registrar’s rules

 Latest versions of each volume of the rules:

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 1: Requirements for Electronic Documents ( PDF , 755 KB , 73 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 2A: Upload Service ( PDF , 915 KB , 104 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 2: Requirements for Paper Documents ( PDF , 2.48 MB , 167 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 3: Requirements for CDs or DVDs ( PDF , 25.9 KB , 5 pages ) 

 • The Registrar’s (Requirements for Informal Correction) Rules 2009 - Volume 4 (repealed)

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 5 : Authentication of a Certificate ( PDF , 86.6 KB , 4 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 6: Nomination of Default Address ( PDF , 223 KB , 3 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 7 : Register of Overseas Entities ( PDF , 292 KB , 18 pages ) 

 The registrar is also given authority to make rules governing identity verification and applying to become an Authorised Corporate Service Provider (ACSP):

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 8: Identity Verification by the Registrar ( PDF , 233 KB , 11 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 9 : Identity Verification by Authorised Corporate Service Providers ( PDF , 151 KB , 7 pages ) 

 • 
 Registrar’s Rules – Volume 10 : Requirements for Applications to become an Authorised Corporate Service Provider ( PDF , 130 KB , 7 pages )
